question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Abominable
solution:
The correct answer is '**Admirable**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Abominable**' is '**Admirable**'.
 
• **Abominable**: घिनौना- causing moral revulsion or hatred.
 
 
• *Example: The **abominable** act of animal cruelty is a serious offense that should be punished by law.*
 
 
 
• **Admirable**: प्रशंसनीय (Prashansaniya) - deserving of respect and approval.
 
 
• *Example: Her **admirable** work towards the betterment of society earned her many accolades.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Admirable.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Worthy**: महत्वपूर्ण - deserving of respect and attention.
 
• **Delectable**: सुखदायक - delicious and pleasing to taste.
 
• **Detestable**: घिनौना - deserving of hatred and disgust.
